message.content: The scientist most widely credited with first proposing the modern theory of evolution by natural selection is **Charles Darwin**. His 1859 book *On the Origin of Species* laid out the mechanism of natural selection and provided extensive evidence for the common descent of all living organisms. (Earlier thinkers such as Jean-Baptiste Lamarck had suggested evolutionary ideas, but Darwin’s formulation became the foundational framework for evolutionary biology.)
